result.summary: The interface presents minor layout and accessibility concerns related to content readability and visual assets.

issues.description: Promo banner text has insufficient color contrast against the light background.
issues.suggestion: Darken font color to meet WCAG readability standards.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used where users expect realistic food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace icons with high-quality restaurant-specific images.

issues.description: Right-most horizontal card content is partially clipped without clear visual cues.
issues.suggestion: Improve spacing or add a more obvious scroll indicator.
